title: Chapter 715
text:
The players were dazzled by the sight of an individual fighting against a fleet. It was like a top-notch special effects movie. This light, this fire, ah!

The last time they saw Han Xiao in action, he did not have such overwhelming combat power. It seemed that too many changes had happened in the past ten years …

Mad Blade felt an inexplicable sense of vicissitudes.

Pork Bun's eyes sparkled. He slapped Mad Blade's butt and hurriedly asked, "Hey, didn't you say that our strength will continue to be unlocked with the version? Does that mean that we will all be able to destroy fleets in the future? That's interesting! "

"It should be possible …" Mad Blade had no idea. According to his idea, since the Galaxy power system would not change, the effect of them becoming stronger would also affect the NPCs' view of them. This was also a real-time calculation world with a high degree of freedom. Perhaps they could reach Black Star's combat power in the future?

Maple Moon was deep in thought. She felt that the effect of all the players leveling up was not as simple as becoming stronger in PK.

This small episode did not affect the speed of the spaceships. Hundreds of spaceships were approaching the atmosphere of planet K- 00156. The artificial intelligence system had already started the countdown for the airdrop.

Under Philip's urging, the three hundred thousand players were ready to go. They boarded the airdrop cabins and were eager to give it a try.

One by one, the space coffin-like airdrop cabins slid into the orbit. Mad Blade, Pork Bun, Maple Moon, and a large group of other players were in the same airdrop cabin. All of them took out their weapons. Even Espers and Pugilists were equipped with firearms as a standard means of combat.

Maple Moon frowned. Suddenly, she thought of something.

"Right, Black Star destroyed the enemy's battleship. Can't we just attack the ground from outer space? Why do we need to airdrop?"

Everyone was stunned. However, before they could think about it, the next moment, the airdrop cabins shook violently. Everyone felt weightless.

Boom boom boom!

Han Xiao hovered beside the fleet and looked down at the planet below him. The airdrop cabins were like burning meteorites, drawing a blazing trajectory and shrinking into tiny dots, landing in the bases on the surface.

Han Xiao enlarged his field of vision. On the ground, the airdrop cabins released an endless stream of players, which turned into a flood and swept out. This planet had many bases on the surface. Numerous Bloodshed Land officers led troops to fight against the players. The players with their own abilities fought fiercely against the Thousand Beast Soldiers and Musclehead warriors. The strongest person guarding the enemy was only Grade B, and they were forced to retreat in front of the fearless players.

"Not bad, I should be able to earn a huge amount of EXP this time." Han Xiao had no intention of helping. He sat cross-legged in outer space and overlooked the battle. Countless individuals the size of grains of sand were exchanging fire with weapons in their hands, causing explosions on the surface of the earth.

He had taken the initiative to apply to deal with the smallest peripheral base station system. The three planetary bases and the warp station were the fertilizer he had prepared for the players.

Other than the battle missions and faction missions, these Bloodshed Land warriors stationed on the surface were all walking EXP. Killing them all would give the players a lot of EXP.

With his level, killing these small fries would only give him + 1 EXP. However, the players were different. Their levels were low, and they could increase the benefits of killing these enemies countless times. He could then harvest this EXP from the players. This was a perfect production chain. It was like feeding chickens to lay eggs!

"The players are getting stronger and stronger. Like in my previous life, they will slowly step onto a bigger stage and be exposed to stronger and stronger organizations." Han Xiao sighed to himself.

In his previous life, as the players' strength increased and they became active in various parts of the universe, many powerful Galaxy organizations paid attention to the players. In the middle and later versions of his previous life, the players even had a famous nickname in the Galaxy.

The Cancer of the Universe!

Han Xiao had always felt that this nickname was very cool and appropriate.

However, now, the players were still very far away from this standard. The first and second batch of core players in Version 3.0 had reached Grade B, and this was the beginning of the rise of the players.

As a farmer who wanted to spread the Radiance of Leeks all over the universe, Han Xiao knew that he still had a long way to go.

"Your Excellency Black Star, are we not going to help?"

Just as Han Xiao was looking down at the planet in deep thought, Marian, who was in heavy armor, flew to Han Xiao's side and asked if they should support the ground troops.

He was one of the three Calamity Grade Supers that had joined seven years ago. He was a strong Mechanical Pugilist who was silent and focused on improving his strength. He could be considered loyal and was quite trusted by Han Xiao.

"There's no need. This is training. You have other things to do." Han Xiao waved his hands.

Marian nodded.

"This planet is under attack, so the hyperdrive base station will definitely open a fast reinforcement channel. I need you to attack the hyperdrive base station when the reinforcements arrive and take control of it. Then, send me quickly to the other two planet strongholds through the wormhole channel of the base station. I will destroy all the flying vehicles and lead the troops to clear them out," Han Xiao said.

He wanted to turn the ground troops of the three planet strongholds into lambs waiting to be slaughtered and destroy their means of escape. He wanted them to be trapped on the planet strongholds, and not a single one of them would be able to escape.

Han Xiao still wanted to say something, but his eyes suddenly flashed as he sensed the change in spacetime. He chuckled and said, "The two of you, prepare yourselves. Death is coming."

As soon as he said that, a whirlpool-like blue wormhole channel appeared in the outer space of planet K- 00156 and spat out battleships one after another.

Sylvia did not say anything and decisively increased the propulsion power of her armor. She turned into a stream of light and agilely dodged the laser cannons, charging into the wormhole channel.

Marian followed closely behind. His performance was much more violent, directly opening up dozens of layers of shields and charging into the wormhole. Along the way, he even smashed through two small assault spaceships.

Both of them were Mechanical Pugilists, and the mechanical suits on them were powerful equipment that Han Xiao had carefully improved. Together with their Calamity Grade strength, it was enough to control a hyperdrive base station that did not have any high-level combatants. Furthermore, both of their suits were installed with Philip's sub-program, which indirectly increased his data range. When the two of them went over, he would be able to remotely assist them and invade the base station.

The reinforcements continued to appear, and their numbers increased. Han Xiao floated in the air with his legs crossed. The improved eleventh generation Watcher Instrument automatically defended, and a total of 361 blue-gold floating guards surrounded him, forming an extremely thick psionic shield that blocked the bombardment of the enemy fleet.

"I'm not in a hurry now. I'll play with you guys."

Han Xiao grinned, and with a thought, a terrifying stream of data blasted toward the artificial intelligence system of these battleships. In the blink of an eye, the artificial intelligence firewall of these spaceships was riddled with holes, and the calculation module became unstable. "Ah, no, I'm going to die, I'm going to die!"

After going through so many Class Advancements, his Virtual Technology skills had been strengthened to a whole new level. The strength and speed of his invasion were incomparable to before. Furthermore, he had also obtained a new Cutting-Edge Knowledge from the Amethyst Civilization, [Quantum Matrix Thought Field]. His data range had increased by countless times, and his invasion method had undergone a revolutionary change. Han Xiao could already directly connect to the quantum network.

Within the range of this range, he could create a torrent of data with just a thought. His invasion ability was strong, and things like porn in his brain were not a problem at all. This was the signature ability of a Virtual Mechanic.

Han Xiao had become stronger in all aspects. Although he had not reached the Beyond Grade A realm, he was already worthy of being called a high-level expert in the galaxy.

A Virtual Mechanic was a killing machine in the galactic battlefield. Even if Han Xiao did not use the Mech Legion, he could still easily deal with small fleets. While he was invading, he sent out the elite Mech Legion to board the battleships and eliminate the enemy personnel. He was not in a hurry now, so he planned to reduce the damage and seize these battleships.

The battle was done with ease, and there was not much pressure. Han Xiao retracted part of his attention and decided to check the situation of the players.

…

On the surface of planet K- 00156, inside a certain stronghold, there was already a tragic battlefield.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

More than ten large-caliber armor-piercing explosive bullets wrapped in Mechanical Force pierced through the body of a Thousand Beast Soldier. Flesh and blood scattered all over the ground. Frenzied Sword kicked away the corpse that crashed into him due to inertia. He then raised his arm and unfolded an alloy wrist shield, blocking a series of blaster shots. He calculated the durability in his heart and charged forward with large strides. With a slide kick, he charged into the midst of a five-man enemy squad. He threw out his electromagnetic chain and spiral knife, engaging in a battle for a while before finally killing the five of them.

After taking a deep breath, he looked around. This was the hub hall of this stronghold, and countless players were fighting with the enemy in the hall. Cannon fire crisscrossed, and the ground was filled with the corpses of the enemy. The players who died turned into white light and revived, not leaving behind a corpse. Therefore, the scene looked like a one-sided massacre, like a swarm of locusts.

The players spontaneously formed small teams and cooperated with each other in battle. The sound of cannon fire was mixed with energetic shouts.

"Pull the monsters, pull the monsters! Back row, attack!"

"Main tank, hold steady and inject life support hormones. Secondary and tertiary tanks, get ready to take over at any time!"

"Mechanics, quickly set up the cannons. What the f * ck are you standing there for?"

"Haha, we've made a killing. One Thousand Beast Soldier gave us so much EXP … What the f * ck, who the f * ck stole my kill!"

The Esper class players showed their abilities, and all kinds of energy waves were released continuously. With their fearlessness, they forced the enemy to retreat again and again. The players had the advantage in numbers, and their individual strength was also not bad. They were all at least Grade C. There were even a few Ten Mile Slope players who had accumulated quite a lot of EXP from the previous version who had risen to Grade B. Furthermore, they had their biggest trump card, revival!

With such a force, what was the need for scouting, probing, feinting, sneak attacks, and ambushes? All they needed to do was airdrop!

Mad Blade directly broke through the blockade line and rushed into the corridor of the stronghold base. Although the battle mission only required him to clear the stronghold, he was very experienced and knew that killing the officers and commanders of the stronghold would definitely greatly increase his mission rating. Thus, he decided to abandon the small fries and search for the enemy's headquarters.

There were quite a few players who had the same idea, so Mad Blade did not dare waste any time.

At the same time, in the headquarters of this stronghold, the surveillance equipment that was still working showed the dozens of areas where the battle had broken out. The stronghold commander's face was pale, and his legs were trembling uncontrollably. He was both shocked and furious.

"This is … the Black Star Corps' Immortal Troop!"

The stronghold commander bit his lips and panicked. As the enemy, the people of Bloodshed Land all knew about the Black Star Corps. This Immortal Troop was the hidden trump card of the Black Star Corps. They had disappeared for ten whole years, and now they had appeared again!

Despair rose in his heart. The terror of the Immortal Troop was already displayed in front of him through the surveillance cameras. This group of people was extremely bloodthirsty and did not leave a single one of their subordinates alive. It would not be long before they washed the stronghold with blood. Their spaceships had already been destroyed by Black Star in outer space, and they had nowhere to run.

"How's the support fleet?" The stronghold commander still held on to the last glimmer of hope.

"We sent out seventeen messages, but the other party did not reply. We have lost contact with the support fleet. Black Star has probably already …" The intelligence officer's face was filled with panic.

The stronghold commander was completely desperate. He had no choice but to watch his death approach.

"Why don't we just …"

Boom!

Before he could finish, the door exploded, and Mad Blade rushed in through the smoke. Without any hesitation, he changed to a mechanical melee weapon and waved the High Frequency Axe, slashing anyone he saw.

"Wait, I'm the manager of the stronghold. I surrender!"

As the axe approached, the stronghold commander was scared out of his wits. He begged for mercy in a panic, raised his hands, and knelt down.

The axe stopped ten centimeters above the stronghold commander's head. The stronghold commander's lips trembled, and his body almost went limp. This time, Mad Blade poked his head out and looked at him with confusion.

"You're the commander?"

"I am!"

"You surrender?"

"That's right, that's right!"

Mad Blade paused for a moment, mumbled, and exerted force on his wrist. The High Frequency Axe directly split the stronghold commander, who thought he had escaped death, in half.

Shaking off the blue blood on the axe, Mad Blade shook his head.

"You didn't even trigger a mission when you surrendered. What's the point of having you … Yo, so much EXP for killing a sergeant?"

Frenzied Blade was overjoyed as he turned around and left. His figure disappeared at the door of the room, leaving behind a pile of corpses and a wall full of blood.

…

At the same time, inside the Hyperdrive Base Station.

The long alloy sword was being dragged by a slender hand. Golden red energy arcs flowed on the sword, and the tip of the sword left a deep mark on the hard metal floor as if it was cutting tofu.

This was an alloy corridor, and the front and back were filled with Bloodshed Land soldiers. They were closing in, and the light cannons were focused on the tall beauty in armor in the middle. However, they were blocked by the armor shield enhanced by Mechanical Force and could not stop her from moving forward.

Sylvia seemed to have ignored the army that was attacking her from the front and back. She turned around and looked at the porthole in the corridor. Marian, who was wearing a heavy mechanical suit, was fighting against the defense fleet outside, having a good time.

"Quickly take down the base station. Don't let Teacher wait for too long."

Sylvia mumbled to herself. She suddenly grabbed the hilt of the sword with both hands and swung it.

In space, the soldiers who were piloting spaceships to attack Marian could clearly see that the interior of the Hyperdrive Base Station had suddenly exploded with a bright golden red ring, directly splitting the entire base station into two halves, cutting off one-fifth of the area.

"Why are you even more violent than me? Don't destroy the base station. We still need it!" Marian said helplessly.

…

In the outer space of planet K- 00156, Han Xiao floated in space and waited silently. More than half of the reinforcement fleet had been captured by him, and they were lying on the side obediently.

This time, a wormhole channel opened again, and on the other side was the second stronghold. The remaining defense fleet was huddled together as if they were shouting in panic, "Don't come over!"

Han Xiao smiled.

Three bags of fertilizer, not one less.
